links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid ease and grade level) of AI-generated breast cancer surgery patient brochures
links.effect: No significant difference between tools in syllables per word or ease score; Gemini had longer sentences and a higher grade-level score (p=0.002), indicating more complex text.
links.quote: Gemini generated longer sentences and a higher grade-level score (p=0.002), indicating relatively more complex text.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation comparing patient education materials generated by ChatGPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Flash using readability metrics and DISCERN scoring, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
